title: Statistics view
body:
I’d like to see:
- Yearly / monthly review in a form of git like PR overview screen.
- More widget options
author: Makragić

title: Nice and neat
body:
It wasn't clear for me from the description if the tasks could be not daily ones (call a friend at least three times a week), but they could
Overall, it packs everything I need and a little more into an easy interface
author: skaurus

title: Amazing habit tracking (and forming) app
body: Simple, easy to use, doesn't get in the way. I really dislike when organizational/gtd/tracking apps become a chore in their own right, and this is anything but. Great app, kudos to the developers.
author: findingsimo

title: Life changing app!!!
body:
One of the few apps that I can truly give an “life changing” medal. Super simple and easy to use app and yet so helpful with little tasks that follow you through the day.
Its a “to do” app that makes me feel as satisfied as when crossing the tasks with a pencil on the paper.
author: Kularos

title: Awful user experience
body: Hard to use app. Colors are done properly, by looking at the watch dots I dont know what is crossed and what isnt as habits have different colors. Stats are terrible to track. Calendar view doesn’t really exist, you have to open the app on your phone. App needs to be reimagined differently
author: neolukas

title: Pretty cool!
body:
App seems pretty cool, only thing thats missing for me is money addition in negative tasks - for example add 20$ to counter for each succesful day so I can see total spared for not smoking (or any other). 
Other thing that I kinda don't like is bottom menu when in edit mode - buttons are pretty small and color selection is pretty irrelevant there because once I choose theme I'll probably stick with it (theme selection should be in detailed settings section for example).

Overall awesome app!
author: Mujo32145

title: Simple and great
body:
I like apps like this, simple and focused on doing few things but doing them great.
Small things like figuring out automatically what icon to use according to text that I input for the task/reminders, show that you are thinking about details! :)
author: bsevo

title: Simple, but incredibly useful
body: The app is really simple to use and never overwhelming. It has just enough customization and looks really nice.
author: TurtlePluto

title: Поставил приложение - улучшил качество жизни
body: Начал пользоваться Streaks. Сбросил несколько кг веса (и продолжаю), сэкономил денег (и продолжаю), снова начал дарить жене цветы и стараться её радовать другими способами (и продолжаю). Нужны ещё рекомендации :)?
author: Stomillionov
